headline: The Last Dance takes the floor as ARC3’s top five hold

sections.heading: Clear the floor
sections.text: The Last Dance remains fifth at 51.51, with yktori less than half a point behind. Today’s Early edition gives the four-account contender its reserved full feature: Florian Sestak, Lukas Aichberger and Mykyta Ielanskyi bring competition experience, robotics and award-winning reasoning research into the same entry. Our October 29 profile and reviewed breakdance cover appear in full with this edition. The fourth account, gklambauer, remains unidentified; its masked dancer is fictional.

sections.heading: The cat keeps its terrace
sections.text: faster machine is all you need holds third at 58.59, ahead of Team Turducken on 56.02. Yesterday’s commissioned breaking report covered the overtake; the overnight wire’s much larger rolling-window gain includes the earlier climb and is not a fresh gain since midnight. Both scores are unchanged against the Early baseline. Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model leads at 75.56, with Tufa Labs second at 70.02.

sections.heading: The chase below the leaders
sections.text: Dipam and Om reach 31st at 37.80, gaining 176 places and 4.92 points against the midnight baseline. Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad rises ten places to twentieth at 39.52, just below the closing gold score of 39.69. Lord Han Solo’s recorded score event lifts 37.07 to 39.94; the closing board places the entry seventeenth. That event supplies context where the edition’s net comparison is unknown. The overnight S@i wire recorded a rise to 66th at 35.20 over its wider reporting window.

sections.heading: Reporting note
sections.text: The featured profile retains its October 29 reporting and cover; surrounding standings use today’s closing observation. Social and discussion research was not refreshed.
